title: Reading and Writing Priority
summary: A 42-day plan for students whose Reading and Writing section trails Math: most study time goes to R&W, starting with rule-based conventions and expression of ideas, then evidence and craft, with daily reading and Math kept warm.

resources.label: SAT Practice Bank (filter by domain, skill and difficulty)

error_codes.meaning: Content: did not know the rule, formula or skill
Process: knew it but set it up or read it wrongly
Time: rushed or ran out of time
Named slip: a specific, nameable careless error
Guess-right: correct but unsure; review as a miss

schedule.who_for: Your R&W section score is clearly below your Math score (for example by 80 points or more), or R&W errors dominate your Notebook. About 5–8 hours a week (heavier in mock weeks), with roughly three quarters of non-mock time on R&W (including a reading habit) and the rest on Math maintenance.
rules: Rule-based skills first (conventions, transitions, rhetorical synthesis), because they convert fastest; then evidence and craft.
Every R&W question: state the task in three words before reading the choices.
20 minutes of dense nonfiction reading on at least five days a week.
Two short Math maintenance sessions a week; full mock at the start of weeks 1, 3 and 5.

phases.label: Conventions and expression
phases.goal: Boundaries, form/structure/sense, transitions and rhetorical synthesis to automatic.

phases.label: Information and ideas
phases.goal: Central ideas, inferences, textual and quantitative evidence.

phases.label: Craft, structure and hard modules
phases.goal: Words in context, structure, cross-text; hard-module traps and pacing.

weeks.label: Week 1: Baseline and boundaries

tasks: Full timed mock in the SAT simulator (https://sat.schood.online) at your real test time; one sitting with a 10-minute break
Forensic review of the mock: re-solve each missed, guessed and slow question before reading the explanation; assign cause codes C/P/T/X/G; name the trap; write a rule sentence
R&W misses by skill; mark which were C, P, T, X
Read R&W: Standard English Conventions — boundaries (/reading-writing-conventions), 20 min
SAT Practice Bank: 25 medium questions in Standard English Conventions → Boundaries (https://practice.sat.schood.online/bank); review every miss
Log misses and guesses in the Notebook with a cause code and a rule sentence (https://practice.sat.schood.online/notebook)
SAT Practice Bank: 12 medium questions in Algebra (https://practice.sat.schood.online/bank); review every miss
Clear due Reviews (https://practice.sat.schood.online/reviews), 10 min
Read R&W: Standard English Conventions — form, structure and sense (/reading-writing-conventions), 20 min
SAT Practice Bank: 25 medium questions in Standard English Conventions → Form, structure and sense (https://practice.sat.schood.online/bank); review every miss
Read 20 minutes of dense nonfiction (science, history, economics) and summarise each article's claim in one sentence
Re-solve Notebook entries from the last 2–3 days without notes; close only correct re-solves
Clear due Reviews (https://practice.sat.schood.online/reviews), 10 min
Rest day: no SAT work. Optional 20 minutes of reading nonfiction you enjoy

weeks.checkpoint: Pass: R&W misses classified; conventions accuracy rising in the Bank.

weeks.label: Week 2: Transitions and rhetorical synthesis

tasks: Read R&W: Expression of Ideas — transitions (/reading-writing-expression-of-ideas), 20 min
SAT Practice Bank: 20 medium questions in Expression of Ideas → Transitions (https://practice.sat.schood.online/bank); review every miss
SAT Practice Bank: 12 medium questions in Advanced Math (https://practice.sat.schood.online/bank); review every miss
Clear due Reviews (https://practice.sat.schood.online/reviews), 10 min
Read R&W: Expression of Ideas — rhetorical synthesis (/reading-writing-expression-of-ideas), 20 min
SAT Practice Bank: 20 medium and hard questions in Expression of Ideas → Rhetorical synthesis (https://practice.sat.schood.online/bank); review every miss
Count goal verbs aloud on every item
SAT Practice Bank: 20 medium and hard questions in Standard English Conventions, timed at 40 seconds each (https://practice.sat.schood.online/bank); review every miss
Read 15 minutes of dense nonfiction (science, history, economics) and summarise each article's claim in one sentence
Timed R&W module set: 27 mixed R&W questions in 32 minutes from the SAT Practice Bank, timer on
Re-solve Notebook entries from weeks 1–2 without notes; close only correct re-solves
Clear due Reviews (https://practice.sat.schood.online/reviews), 15 min
Checkpoint: conventions and expression misses vs the baseline mock
Rest day: no SAT work. Optional 20 minutes of reading nonfiction you enjoy

weeks.checkpoint: Pass: conventions and expression-of-ideas misses rare in the timed set. If not, repeat week 2 days 1, 3 and 4.

weeks.checkpoint: Pass: two timed R&W modules finished on time with few misses.

checkpoints.title: Rules secure
checkpoints.pass_rule: Conventions and expression misses rare in a timed R&W set.
checkpoints.if_not: Repeat week 2 before Information and Ideas.

checkpoints.title: Evidence secure
checkpoints.pass_rule: Evidence misses fall from mock 2; TT errors rare.

checkpoints.title: Section ready
checkpoints.pass_rule: Two timed R&W modules on time with few misses.
checkpoints.if_not: Repeat week 6 with new question sets.
